profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer @ Capital One | AWS Certified Solutions Architect
profile.summary:
With over a decade of experience in software engineering, I currently serve as a Lead Software Engineer at Capital One. I am passionate about building scalable, efficient systems that enhance customer engagement. My core competencies lie in full-stack cloud services development and creating intuitive UI/UX. I am committed to advancing Capital One's mission to change banking for good.

At Capital One, I lead a team in developing impactful, full-stack cloud solutions using tools like TypeScript, Java, Python, DynamoDB, and AWS. My recent work focuses on re-marketing services, driving customer engagement and boosting dealership connections to their customers. I actively mentor junior engineers, ensuring a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence across the organization.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
I drove impactful technology initiatives at Capital One, enhancing re-marketing services for auto dealerships that increased customer engagement.  

• Developed and implemented full-stack cloud services, resulting in improved system performance, uptime, and customer engagement using TypeScript, Java, Python, DynamoDB and other AWS tools.  
• Led a team to create innovative re-marketing solutions, significantly boosting dealership customer engagement and driving auto sales for dealerships.  
• Actively mentored junior engineers, promoting a culture of continuous learning and professional growth.
positions.insights: Amazon Web Services (AWS), TypeScript and +3 skills

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
As a Senior Software Engineer at Capital One, I specialized in architecting and developing micro-frontend systems to unify business-critical applications. My work focused on using Lit and Solid.js to build modular, reusable components that streamlined development and enhanced performance.

I was the lead engineer for the Prequal MFE, an achievement I am particularly proud of. This micro-frontend, built in Lit, successfully unified all pre-qualification applications across Capital One Auto Finance into a single, cohesive user experience, which significantly improved efficiency and consistency across all Financial Services.

I also built the QR Code generator, later named Muse, a micro-frontend designed to serve as a dealership associate attribution engine. This innovative tool, one of the first production applications at Capital One to leverage Solid.js, allowed dealership associates to directly share inventory with customers and receive attribution for final sales.

In addition to my front-end specialization, my full-stack expertise allowed me to bridge the gap between user experience and back-end systems. I designed and implemented the cloud architecture for these projects, ensuring their scalability and reliability and delivering robust, impactful solutions.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
I specialized in architecting and developing robust, user-centric front-end solutions for Capital One's Auto Navigator. I have extensive experience in UI application architecture and design patterns, consistently translating complex business requirements into manageable, responsive digital experiences. I was also instrumental in designing and implementing applications with a focus on comprehensive UI/UX, leveraging my expertise in responsive design principles to ensure a seamless experience across all devices.

As a software engineer, I led strategic projects and upheld a high bar for code quality and collaboration. I am well-versed in Agile and Kanban methodologies, which enabled our teams to deliver high-impact features efficiently. My efforts included building and maintaining a comprehensive suite of unit and functional tests to ensure the reliability and integrity of our software. A key focus of my work was ensuring digital products were compliant with accessibility standards using semantic HTML. I have significant experience with web frameworks like Angular and React, as well as AWS cloud computing to build scalable and performant applications.
positions.insights: Amazon Web Services (AWS), Angular and +3 skills

positions.title: Web Developer Intern
positions.description: During my internship at Domo, I played a key role in developing a bookmarklet tool that empowered clients to extract insights from various data sources. This innovative solution was built using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Node.js, and lived inside the user's web browser, significantly enhancing the functionality of Domo's business intelligence software. My contributions helped streamline data visualization in Domo dashboards, ultimately improving client satisfaction and engagement.
positions.insights: JavaScript, Document Object Model (DOM) and +3 skills

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: At BYU Broadcasting, I significantly improved the functionality of web and mobile applications, focusing on backend development. My work with C# services and a NoSQL database enhanced performance, while a custom JavaScript framework I helped developed built around IIFE (Immediately Invoked Function Expressions) improved front-end efficiency. These contributions led to a more responsive user experience on byutvsports.com.

positions.title: GSD Supervisor Collaboration Team
positions.description: At The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-Day Saints, I played a pivotal role in resolving email and messaging infrastructure challenges for a diverse workforce. My commitment to customer service and quick problem-solving led to numerous awards and direct client requests. By working closely with various teams, I significantly improved communication and operational efficiency across the organization.

company.name: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-Day Saints
